Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Why should you let your kids eat (some) junk food!Claire Martin, a professor specialising in health, believes it is better for parents to let their children occasionally eat calorie-laden salty and sweet snacks rather than trying to eliminate them from their diets altogether. questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Unhealthy, high-calorie snacks.) है।
